title: Same-line SPC2-ST-B2 perturbation direction: iAT1-directed → SOX2lowCFTR+ vs culture-format-only → Proliferating progenitors
basis_rows: GSM6858856_L_DCI (SOX2lowCFTR+); GSM5819133_iAEC2_3D (Prolif. prog.); GSM5819134_iAEC2_3D_insert (Prolif. prog.); GSM5819135_iAEC2_MRC5_insert (Prolif. prog.); GSE289846_3i_Day7 (Prolif. prog.); GSE289846_3i_LATS_Day14 (SOX2lowCFTR+)
hypothesis: Within same-line SPC2-ST-B2, explicit iAT1-directed perturbation (e.g. L+DCI or LATS-IN-1) drives epithelial_top_state_fine toward SOX2lowCFTR+ cells, whereas culture-format-only variation (3D / insert / +MRC5 without lineage-directing medium) retains Proliferating progenitors identity with low epithelial off-target
success_condition: A future same-line SPC2-ST-B2 tranche containing both (a) an explicit iAT1-directed condition and (b) a culture-format-only condition shows: (a) epithelial_top_state_fine = SOX2lowCFTR+ cells for the iAT1-directed rows AND (b) epithelial_top_state_fine = Proliferating progenitors for the culture-format-only rows, with epi off-target < 5% for the culture-format rows
falsification_condition: (i) A culture-format-only SPC2-ST-B2 row maps to SOX2lowCFTR+ cells instead of Proliferating progenitors, OR (ii) an explicit iAT1-directed SPC2-ST-B2 row retains Proliferating progenitors and does not shift toward SOX2lowCFTR+, OR (iii) direction is inconsistent across replicates within the same condition
validation_target_tranche: Next same-line Kotton/BU SPC2-ST-B2 tranche with explicit iAT1-directed condition split
note: GSE289846 (Kyoto, B2-3) supports the same direction cross-lab: 3i_Day7 = Prolif. progenitors, LATS_Day14 = SOX2lowCFTR+. GSE193716 held primary AEC2 rows are NOT a validation target for this prediction because they are adult primary tissue, not iPSC-derived, and the adult-primary-vs-fetal caveat is unresolved.
